test_title: PYST 14: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 26th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Desert
solution:
The correct answer is '**Abandon**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Desert**' is '**Abandon**'.
 
• **Desert**: to leave somebody/something, usually forever. [किसी को (प्रायः सदा के लिए) छोड़ जाना]
 
 
• *Example: Many people have **deserted** the countryside and moved to the towns.*
 
 
 
• **Abandon**: to leave somebody/something that you are responsible for, usually permanently. (किसी प्राणी या वस्‍तु को, जिस का उत्तरदायित्‍व आप पर है, प्रायः सदा के लिए छोड़ देना)
 
 
• *Example: The bank robbers **abandoned** the car just outside the city.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Abandon.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Help**: to do something for somebody in order to be useful or to make something easier for him/her. (किसी की सहायता करना)
 
• **Support**: to help somebody by saying that you agree with him/her/it, and sometimes giving practical help such as money.[किसी को (सहमति के आधार पर) समर्थन देना या किसी की (धन देकर) सहायता करना]
 
• **Stay**: to continue to be somewhere and not go away. [किसी स्‍थान पर ठहरे रहना (वहाँ से चले न जाना)] 
 
 

3a:T592,

The erroneous part is** 'He want'.**
